description: This file declares the HttpDecoder class and related interfaces for decoding HTTP frames over QUIC, including visitor callbacks for different frame types and parsing logic.

classes.name: HttpDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding HTTP frames exchanged in HTTP over QUIC sessions, with callback mechanisms for different frame types.

classes.name: HttpDecoder::Visitor
classes.description: Interface for handling callbacks during HTTP frame decoding, including error handling and specific frame processing.

classes.name: HttpDecoder::Options
classes.description: Configuration options for HttpDecoder, such as enabling WEBTRANSPORT_STREAM parsing.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data, invoking visitor callbacks until completion or error.

methods.name: DecodeSettings
methods.description: Decodes a settings frame from raw data into a SettingsFrame object.
